issues.description: Removing 'category__in' from DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES drops the active-filter badge for the new findings Category filter.
issues.detail: ui/components/filters/active-filter-badge.tsx had a default badge config for category__in that this PR deletes. Now that Category is a real, user-facing filter on the findings page, the active filter badge will not appear when the user selects a category, contradicting the PR's stated 'Active Filter Badges' goal and making the filter less discoverable to clear.

issues.description: Active filter badge for Category will show raw IDs (e.g. 'iam', 'internet-exposed') instead of formatted labels.
issues.detail: The findings filter now uses getCategoryLabel as labelFormatter for the dropdown, but active-filter badges and selected-value chips elsewhere read raw filter values. Users will see 'iam' or 'forensics-ready' in active filter chips while the dropdown shows 'IAM' / 'Forensics Ready', producing inconsistent UX.

issues.description: getCategoryLabel heuristics will mislabel legitimate non-acronym short words and lose previously curated labels.
issues.detail: Old code had an explicit mapping (e.g. 'trustboundaries' -> 'Trust Boundaries', 'forensics-ready' -> 'Forensics Ready'). The new heuristic uppercases any word <=3 chars and otherwise just title-cases. Words like 'aws', 'gcp' work, but 'New', 'Old', 'Web' would become 'NEW', 'OLD', 'WEB'; 'trustboundaries' becomes 'Trustboundaries'. Regression vs. the previous curated labels.

issues.description: CategorySelector cannot deselect once a category is chosen; 'all' is the only path back and dropdown state may desync.
issues.detail: selectedCategory is derived from selectedPoint?.categoryId, but clicking a radar dot sets selectedPoint while the Select's controlled value is only 'all' or a category id. Clicking elsewhere on the radar (e.g., handleBarClick navigation) or programmatic updates may leave the Select showing a stale category. Also no keyboard escape resets to null.

issues.description: Adding 'Info: 4' to SEVERITY_ORDER as a duplicate of 'Informational' can break ordering/grouping if both keys appear in data.
issues.detail: ui/components/graphs/shared/constants.ts now maps both 'Informational' and 'Info' to 4. If upstream data ever mixes the two labels, sorts that key by SEVERITY_ORDER will treat them as equal but render as two distinct buckets in legends/axes. Prefer normalizing the incoming value to a single canonical label rather than aliasing the order map.

issues.description: horizontal-bar-chart recomputes maxValue inside the .map for every row.
issues.detail: ui/components/graphs/horizontal-bar-chart.tsx computes Math.max(...data.map(...)) on each iteration of the outer map (line ~64). For small N this is fine, but it should be hoisted above the map for clarity and to avoid O(n^2) work as the dataset grows. Minor refactor.

review.summary: The PR adds a Risk Radar view, a shared getCategoryLabel utility, and a Category filter on findings. Two regressions stand out: removing the category__in entry from DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES disables the active-filter badge for the new Category filter, and replacing the explicit CATEGORY_LABELS map with heuristics quietly degrades previously curated labels like 'Trust Boundaries'. The CategorySelector control can desync from radar clicks, and aliasing 'Info' to 'Informational' in SEVERITY_ORDER risks duplicate buckets. Rename-only changes from 'Threat Score' to 'Prowler ThreatScore' look intentional and safe.
